disaster_name: Annamayya Dam Failure & Cheyyeru Flash Flood (19 November 2021)
region: Rajampet and Nandalur Mandals, Annamayya District (formerly Kadapa), Andhra Pradesh, India

evidence_standards.OBSERVED: Direct sensor, gauge, or physical survey measurement
evidence_standards.OFFICIAL_ESTIMATE: Documented in government situation report or official committee memo
evidence_standards.MODEL_RECONSTRUCTION: Derived from validated hydrologic or hydraulic engineering formulations
evidence_standards.ASSUMED: Engineering scenario parameter bounded by uncertainty intervals

catchment_rainfall_mm.source: IMD / APSDPS Daily Weather Bulletins (18-19 Nov 2021)

pincha_storage_mcm.source: AP Irrigation Dept Medium Irrigation Register / CWC

pincha_failure_mechanism.description: Overtopping and washout of temporary ring bund
pincha_failure_mechanism.source: AP Irrigation & CAD Department / CWC Technical Appraisal (2021)

pincha_failure_time.source: Local Irrigation Log / District Situation Report

pincha_to_annamayya_distance_km.source: Survey of India GIS River Line / HydroRIVERS

pincha_surge_travel_time_min.source: Muskingum 1D routing + eye-witness logs (wave speed ~4.5 m/s)

annamayya_frl_m.source: AP Irrigation Engineering Records / Original Drawings

annamayya_bund_top_level_m.source: Technical Expert Committee Report (2021) / Restoration DPR (2022)

annamayya_gross_volume_mcm.source: National Register of Large Dams (CWC) / AP Irrigation

spillway_operating_discharge_m3s.source: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) National Situation Report D692

peak_total_inflow_annamayya_m3s.source: MHA Report D692 vs CWC Technical Appraisal (2021) vs IISc (2023)

breach_time_ist.source: District Collectorate Records / MHA Report D692

eroded_embankment_length_m.source: AP Irrigation Restoration DPR dt 30-10-2022 (EE Kadapa)
eroded_embankment_length_m.usage: Structural bound on breach erosion, NOT instantaneous width
